deals.description: ✨ LAST DAY at Vienna’s most iconic summer spot! 🎬🍛 If you haven’t been yet, today is your LAST chance! 😍 The Film Festival at Rathausplatz is the perfect summer evening — amazing music, a huge outdoor screen, beautiful vibes and SO much food… all with FREE ENTRY! 🤩❤️ And this time, I had to try Daily Spice 🌶️ bringing Indian & Bangla flavours to the festival with delicious dosa, curry & samosas! 😋🔥 📍 Rathausplatz, Vienna 🗓️ Last day: 6 September 🎟️ FREE ENTRY Tag someone who needs to make one last summer visit! 👇🏻✨ #filmfestivalrathausplatz #rathausplatz #viennaevents #viennafood #viennaeats
